services.desc: Looking for a fishing charter or dolphin tour in the Cocoa beach area, Cast Away Adventures has you covered. Providing funs and affordable inshore fishing and dolphin tours since 2013, we have a charter or tour for you. Give us a call to enjoy a day on the water. Firstly, the weather has been great here on the Space Coast, couldn’t be more excited about that! September is a great time of year but you never know what you may get. With this run of good fortune (weather-wise) it is a really great time to be here and be on the water. Cast Away Adventures welcomes you aboard our comfortable 26′ deck boat for our fishing charter and dolphin tours in Cocoa Beach. Spend a day on the calm lagoon

blurb: Cast Away Adventures offers inshore saltwater fishing charters and dolphin and manatee tours in Cocoa Beach, Florida. Tours run year round on calm waters of the Banana River Lagoon, suitable for all ages and skill levels. The 26' deck boat accommodates up to 6 passengers and includes all fishing gear and licenses.
